notes: Fiscal year ended December 28, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Filings: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000050863-25-000009) and 2025 proxy statement (accession 0000050863-25-000054), both read on www.sec.gov. GORDON MOORE is deceased. The 2025 proxy's ownership table lists only directors, NEOs, Vanguard and BlackRock; it shows no Moore estate, trust or Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation holding, and 'Moore' appears in the 10-K only as Moore's Law. Family is therefore null. BUYBACKS: zero. The cash-flow statement has no repurchase line for 2024, and the 10-K says the last repurchase was in Q1 2021. The only share-related outflow, $631 million of restricted stock unit withholdings, is not a buyback. DIVIDENDS: Intel suspended its dividend from Q4 2024. STOCK COMP: Intel tags no separate note total; the $3,410 million is the cash-flow add-back, matching the total of the share-based compensation line in the segment note. HOLDERS: the proxy says the 5% holdings are 'as of December 31, 2024', but it cites 13G/A filings dated January and February 2024, which normally report end-of-2023 holdings. Because of this conflict, asOf is null.
